introduction.title: Who I am
introduction.text: I am Bruno Henrique Freiberger, a software developer with over 12 years of experience in full-stack development. My core expertise lies in Java (Spring) and JavaScript (Angular), delivering scalable, high-quality solutions. I also have hands-on experience with a wide range of technologies and DevOps practices, contributing across the entire development lifecycle.

items.description: Development and maintenance of enterprise solutions, applying software engineering best practices, modern architecture and cross-team collaboration.
Contributed to the enhancement and development of systems focused on healthcare management.
Developed healthcare solutions for insurance providers, focusing on product evolution, reliability and performance.
Worked outsourced at Philips Clinical Informatics. Developed features such as a visual Query Builder in Java and Oracle, enabling healthcare professionals to build queries without SQL knowledge.
Developed and enhanced features in agribusiness software, ensuring quality and continuous improvement.
Worked in a software factory and on outsourcing projects for clients such as Philips, Senior Sistemas, FIESC and Lincros.
Implemented new features and system improvements in the Altimus vehicle dealership management platform.
Developed and maintained MOBUSS Construção, a construction management system used across the civil construction sector.
